title: Four-Round Feistel Correlation Intractability for Binary and Ternary Evasive Relations
summary: Four-round Feistel is not correlation intractable against 4-ary evasive relations with oracle-only round-function access; the binary and ternary cases remain open.

formal_statement.body: The four-round Feistel construction is not correlation intractable against 4-ary evasive relations even when an adversary has only oracle access to the underlying round functions. Determine whether the four-round Feistel construction is correlation intractable against binary or ternary evasive relations in this oracle-only access model.

scope.domain: Block-cipher security, specifically correlation intractability of the four-round Feistel construction against evasive relations.
assumptions: The adversary has only oracle access to the underlying round functions.
parameters: Evasive-relation arity: 4-ary for the known negative result and binary or ternary for the unresolved cases
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the four-round Feistel construction is correlation intractable against binary or ternary evasive relations when the adversary has only oracle access to the underlying round functions.

citations.label: Naor-Reingold Goes Public: The Complexity of Known-Key Security

progress.summary: The source gives a negative result for 4-ary evasive relations under oracle-only round-function access, then explicitly leaves the binary and ternary cases for future work.
citation_labels: Pratik Soni et al., Naor-Reingold Goes Public: The Complexity of Known-Key Security
